Market today: Wall Street's closing a strong quarter, which is generally good for your tech/chip heavy book. However, 10-year Treasury yields are higher, which can put pressure on growth stocks like yours, especially with margin.

Your holdings: SOXL (-33.73%) and SPAL (-31.29%) are flagged "SELL." Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning they decay and drops are amplified, which is extra painful on margin. All other holdings look fine today.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yields; continued increases could challenge your tech positions. Also, watch for follow-through on the "Magnificent Seven" momentum.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged losers aggressively while staying alert to rising interest rates impacting your growth-heavy portfolio.
